_readme: Which sound plays for which lifecycle hook. Data, not code: edit and restart.
sounds.py loads it next to itself, the same way ui.py loads ui.json.
media   play a real WAV via winsound.PlaySound (the nice option)
beep    play the "beep" tones via winsound.Beep (works anywhere)
off     silence. This is the default here on purpose: sound is opt-in,
so nothing makes a noise until you set NANOCODE_SOUND.
Each entry under "sounds" is keyed by a hook event. "file" is used in
media mode; "beep" is [frequency, milliseconds] (or a list of those) - it
is the fallback when the WAV is missing and the only thing in beep mode.
Windows ships these WAVs in C:\Windows\Media\ - tada, ding, chimes,
notify, 'Windows Notify' ... point "file" at any of them.
env overrides: NANOCODE_SOUND_START/_LOOP/_DONE replace the file for
session_start / turn_start / turn_end without editing this file.
